changes: Initial profile capture follows the current request and confirmed profile instead of informational route names.
General location, exact address and map have separate disclosure permissions shared by composition and review.
Visit dialogue preserves requested, offered and accepted destinations; questions about hours do not authorize registration.
The onsite office is configurable independently of physical construction readiness.
Early purchase discounts have editable scope, percentage, source, validity, conditions and independent activation controls.
Discount arithmetic is verified by unit and rule; a conditional reference does not confirm commercial fulfilment.
Review-disabled and transport-only traces do not appear as content approval.

validation.model_response_tests: Controlled fixtures and mocked model calls; no live model quality guarantee.

rollout.without_migration: Prior preferences remain attributed to their original message; the actual handoff fallback does not invent a booking or a successful intake receipt.
